new_learnings.text: When all 3 major indices are green but breadth is below 1:1, it signals mega-cap bifurcation — the index move masks broad weakness. Today: 科创50 +8.41% but 2888 stocks declined vs 2486 advanced. The breadth ratio (not index color) should be the binding constraint on new entries.
new_learnings.mechanism: Large-cap weight in indices means a narrow rally lifts headline numbers while most stocks suffer. Breadth captures the true participation rate.

new_learnings.text: 长鑫科技 IPO (July 16 listing) is a concept/theme catalyst creating a semiconductor supply-chain halo. These event-driven sector surges typically last 3-5 trading days around the event. The pre-IPO window (now through July 15) is the optimal entry zone — but only when breadth supports it.
new_learnings.mechanism: IPO of a major industry player triggers re-rating of peers as markets price in ecosystem value uplift. The effect is strongest pre-listing and typically fades post-listing.

new_learnings.text: Rule 2b (MA distance) filtered 5 of 9 semiconductor candidates today for dist_ma20 > 12%. In sector-wide euphoria, the best stocks gap beyond safe entry zones — the rule prevents buying the top even inside the #1 sector. Confirms h027.
new_learnings.mechanism: Sector surges create uniform upward pressure that pushes many names beyond short-term support; MA-distance discipline distinguishes between sustainable trends and parabolic extensions.
